caption: The drawing depicts a large red heart with noticeable highlights and shading, positioned in the center of a vertically oriented, wooden plaque-like frame. The heart is encircled horizontally by a black chain or crown of thorns adorned with gray-green leaves or rays. At the top of the heart is a golden or beige cross, emerging from what appears to be a flame or burst of red rays. Above the heart, the background is draped with dark green curtains edged in red. Below the heart, there is a gray arm extending from the left side with a hand reaching to the right, showing red lines that resemble wounds or markings. To the bottom right of the heart, there is a small gray vessel with a burst of red flames rising from it. The background within the frame is a light tan color with wood grain texture, and the frame itself is a muted grayish brown. There are visible cracks and wear on the artwork and some string tied at the top center of the frame. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Retablo (Sacred Heart)
